# ModelDummyCreatorEditor

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/Camera/ModelDummyCreatorEditor.cs#L19)

Editor for [`ModelDummyCreator`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/ModelDummyCreator): the instructions, the settings and the button
that takes the picture.

The button lives here rather than in a Tools menu on purpose. A menu item has to guess
which camera it means from the selection and has nowhere to put its settings, so every
resolution and output path ends up hard-coded in the script. On the camera itself there
is no guessing left to do, and the settings are part of the scene that produced the
picture.

```csharp
[CustomEditor(typeof(ModelDummyCreator))]
[CanEditMultipleObjects]
public class ModelDummyCreatorEditor : VRFComponentEditor
```
